text: Often it's about emotions rather than needs. People shop when they're bored, stressed or want to reward themselves after a hard week. Online shops make it dangerously easy — your card details are saved, and you can buy something in two clicks at midnight. Sales and countdown timers also create a feeling that you'll miss out if you don't buy immediately.

tips.en: It's about emotions rather than needs is the core of the answer.
tips.kk: It's about emotions rather than needs — жауаптың өзегі.
tips.ru: It's about emotions rather than needs — ядро ответа.
tips.example: it's about emotions rather than needs

tips.en: Countdown timers creating a fear of missing out is a specific technique.
tips.kk: Countdown timers … a feeling that you'll miss out — нақты айла.
tips.ru: Countdown timers … a feeling that you'll miss out — конкретный приём.
tips.example: you'll miss out if you don't buy immediately

questions.question: Why do people buy things they don't really need?

text: Better than before, but not enough. Big marketplaces usually have a system for refunds, although it can be slow, as I found out. Small sellers on social media are much riskier, because there's often no contract or address. I think platforms should check sellers more carefully and give buyers a clear, simple way to complain within a fixed number of days.

tips.en: Big marketplaces versus riskier small sellers draws a distinction.
tips.kk: Big marketplaces … Small sellers on social media are much riskier — айырмашылық.
tips.ru: Big marketplaces … Small sellers on social media are much riskier — различие.
tips.example: Small sellers on social media are much riskier

tips.en: Within a fixed number of days makes the proposal specific.
tips.kk: Within a fixed number of days — дерегі бар ұсыныс.
tips.ru: Within a fixed number of days — предложение с деталью.
tips.example: within a fixed number of days

questions.question: Are consumers well protected when they shop online?

text: Some of them certainly seem to be. My grandparents' fridge worked for thirty years, while modern phones often slow down after two or three. Part of it is that products are more complex now, but companies also profit when we replace things regularly. Some countries are now introducing rules that make manufacturers provide spare parts, which I think is a step in the right direction.

tips.en: My grandparents' fridge versus modern phones is a clear contrast.
tips.kk: My grandparents' fridge … while modern phones … — көрнекі қарама-қайшылық.
tips.ru: My grandparents' fridge … while modern phones … — наглядный контраст.
tips.example: My grandparents' fridge worked for thirty years

tips.en: Part of it is … but companies also profit … is an honest analysis.
tips.kk: Part of it is … but companies also profit … — шынайы талдау.
tips.ru: Part of it is … but companies also profit … — честный анализ.
tips.example: companies also profit when we replace things regularly

phrases.text: a step in the right direction

questions.question: Are products today made to break more quickly than in the past?

text: When it's possible, repairing is usually better, both for your wallet and for the environment. The problem is that repairs often cost almost as much as a new item, and repair shops are harder to find than they used to be. In my area there's one man who fixes shoes and bags, and he's always busy, so I think demand is still there.

tips.en: Both for your wallet and for the environment gives two reasons at once.
tips.kk: Both for your wallet and for the environment — бірден екі дәлел.
tips.ru: Both for your wallet and for the environment — два довода сразу.
tips.example: both for your wallet and for the environment

tips.en: One man who fixes shoes and is always busy is evidence from real life.
tips.kk: One man who fixes shoes … always busy — өмірден дәлел.
tips.ru: One man who fixes shoes … always busy — доказательство из жизни.

questions.followUp: Why do fewer people repair things today?
questions.question: Is it better to repair things or to replace them?

text: I doubt it. Online shopping will keep growing for everyday items, but people still want to touch clothes, try on shoes and taste food before buying. Shops that offer an experience, like good advice, cafés or events, have a real advantage. The ones most at risk are big stores that sell exactly the same products you can find cheaper online.

tips.en: Touch clothes, try on shoes and taste food points to physical experience.
tips.kk: Touch clothes, try on shoes and taste food — сезімдік тәжірибе.
tips.ru: Touch clothes, try on shoes and taste food — чувственный опыт.
tips.example: people still want to touch clothes, try on shoes and taste food

tips.ru: The ones most at risk are … — ответ на follow-up с другой стороны.
